Subject: Re: Outage on 2026-09-12 - request for service credit and invoice adj

Hi Vanessa,

We're following up after yesterday's partial outage (12 Sep) that caused 2.3 hours of degraded response for our production routing — effectively increased tail latency that impacted several customer-facing features. Per our contract (Section 4.2), we believe this qualifies for a service credit and would like Redwood to propose the calculation and next steps for invoice adjustment.

What we can provide: hourly traffic slices and a confirmed window of impairment (09:04–11:26 PDT).

Request: please confirm whether SableAI is eligible and, if so, provide the credit amount and expected invoice timeline. Our finance team needs any adjustment before our month-end close (2026-09-20).

Thanks,
Elaine
Director of Platform Operations
SableAI

Hi Elaine — thanks for raising this and for the window details. I’m sorry this impacted SableAI’s production traffic.

Quick summary / next steps:
- We’re going to validate the eligible downtime window against our ingress and KV/cache logs.
- I’ll loop in our billing team to calculate the credit per the SLA formula (monthly uptime % / service credit table).
- Can you attach the hourly traffic slices (CSV) and any internal impact notes? That will speed validation.

I’ve CC’d Marissa (ops lead) and Connor (support escalation) to run the logs and produce a draft credit calc. I’ll reconvene once we have numbers — aiming for an agreement and an invoice adjustment before 2026-09-20.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: [Internal] SableAI credit calc — logs attached, need draft by EOD

Marissa / Connor — copying Laura for billing approval path. Elaine sent the outage window 2026-09-12 09:04–11:26 PDT (2h22m degraded). SableAI claims 2.3 hours of impact; customer has hourly traffic CSV ready (they said they'd send).

Please:
1) Pull ingress/serving logs and confirm the percentage of successful token completions during the window vs baseline.
2) Use SLA formula: Service Credit = (Monthly Fee) * (Eligible% from SLA table) depending on monthly uptime. For this customer, monthly committed uptime is 99.95%.
3) Produce an XLSX with the line calculation and attach the incident KV cache logs snippet.

Deadline: draft calc and internal recommendation by today 17:00 PT. If it looks like eligible, Laura — can you pre-approve up to $12k in credit to allow us to hit Sable's close date? We'll escalate beyond that if needed.

Thanks,
Vanessa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 12:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Internal] SableAI credit calc — logs attached, need draft by EOD

Vanessa / team — attached the draft spreadsheet (svc_credit_calc-SableAI-20260914.xlsx) and a trimmed incident_kv_log-20260912.txt. Key notes:

- Baseline monthly uptime before incident (Sep calendar to date): 99.996% (negligible).
- Incident window confirmed across three edge clusters: 09:04–11:26 PDT. Measured error-rate spike and request timeouts consistent with customer reports.
- Using our SLA table: 99.95%–99.99% uptime maps to 5% service credit for the affected month. Because the degradation was partial (not full outage), policy says prorate by the percentage of impacted requests during window.

Calculation (rounded):
- Monthly committed fee: $48,000
- Standard credit tier for 99.95–99.99 = 5% -> $2,400
- Proration factor (impacted request share during window vs monthly requests): 0.31% (their hourly traffic indicates the window represented 0.31% of monthly tokens)
- Prorated credit = $2,400 * 0.0031 = $7.44 -> company practice floors credits to a minimum of $25 for partial degradations.

Recommendation: issue a $25 invoice credit and mark as non-refundable service redress. Rationale: follows SLA table, proration, and internal precedent to avoid micro-credits.

Attachments: svc_credit_calc-SableAI-20260914.xlsx (calc with line items), incident_kv_log-20260912.txt (trim).

Subject: Re: Outage on 2026-09-12 - request for service credit and invoice adj

Hi Elaine — appreciate the quick data you sent earlier. Our internal review is complete. Summary and next steps below.

Summary of findings:
- Incident window confirmed: 2026-09-12 09:04–11:26 PDT.
- Impact: partial degradations (increased tail latency / elevated errors) affecting ~0.31% of monthly token volume.
- SLA band: your contracted uptime (99.95%) maps to a 5% service credit tier for the month. Following our SLA proration rules, this produces a nominal credit amount of $7.44, which we round up per policy to a standard minimum credit of $25 for partial degradations.

Decision: Redwood will issue a $25 credit as a service redress.

Next steps / timeline:
- We will post a credit memo (INV-2026-819) to your September invoice by 2026-09-17.
- Attached: svc_credit_calc-SableAI-20260914.xlsx (calculation) and incident_kv_log-20260912.txt (trim).
- If you need the credit applied to a different billing period or require a signed adjustment, reply and we’ll generate the DocuSign adjustment.

Thanks again for the partnership and for the detailed traffic slices — they helped speed validation. Sorry again for the disruption; the incident postmortem (root cause and mitigations) will be sent separately this week.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Attachments: svc_credit_calc-SableAI-20260914.xlsx (calc), incident_kv_log-20260912.txt (logs)
